author: Cleo Abram
description:
They might drill into King Tut’s tomb… 

The Tomb of Tutankhamen has puzzled archaeologists for decades. Compared to other tombs in the Valley of the Kings this one is pretty cramped and it looks like it was very hastily prepared. It makes sense because he died unexpectedly at a very young age, but archaeologists are wondering… could there be more hidden inside this tomb? 

Well, they may have just found something. For more, subscribe!

title: They Found Something In King Tut’s Tomb
